reasoning: The glyph is an overly abstract geometric shape—a tapered pentagon with an internal inverted Y over a horizontal bar—that cannot be identified at a glance without context. Viewers will split between reading it as a stylized pen/marker nib, an optical port, a lantern, or a gothic window, making it too ambiguous to serve as a reliable visual reminder in a to-do list.
